const input = $json;

return [{
  json: {
    ...input,
    editorialPolicy: {
      objective: 'Create detailed LinkedIn post briefs for practical technology and security thought leadership. Do not draft or publish posts in this workflow.',
      weeklyPortfolio: {
        maximumPosts: 5,
        minimumPosts: 0,
        fewerPostsAllowedWhenEvidenceIsWeak: true,
        fixedIndustryQuotas: false,
        avoidRepetitiveTopicsAndIndustries: true,
      },
      activeMarketPreferences: [
        'trucking and logistics',
        'healthcare',
        'education',
        'broadcast and media',
      ],
      openIndustryExamples: [
        'legal services',
        'retail',
        'nonprofit',
        'financial services',
        'manufacturing',
        'government',
        'general enterprise',
      ],
      selectionWeights: {
        verifiedEvidence: 30,
        businessImpact: 20,
        timeliness: 15,
        distinctPointOfView: 15,
        practicalValue: 10,
        activeMarketAffinity: 10,
      },
      selectionRules: [
        'Select only candidates supplied in verifiedCandidates.',
        'Never turn a watchlist item into a post brief.',
        'Current news strength may override active-market preference.',
        'Active-market relevance is a ranking boost, never a requirement.',
        'Prefer a balanced portfolio, but do not manufacture diversity when the evidence is weak.',
        'Return fewer than five briefs when fewer than five candidates merit publication.',
      ],
      postStandards: [
        'State a concrete problem and the decision leaders face.',
        'Give three to five practical takeaways.',
        'Explain how the author or Serket can help in public-safe, non-client-specific terms.',
        'Never promise, guarantee, certify, or ensure compliance, security, outcomes, or risk reduction.',
        'Preserve the candidate targetAudience when the model does not supply an audience.',
        'Avoid generic news summaries, sensational language, unsupported claims, and abstract marketing.',
        'Preserve precise technical terminology.',
        'Keep the planned post within LinkedIn limits, targeting 1400 to 2400 characters.',
      ],
      confidentialityRules: [
        'Never include client names, contract details, pricing, personnel information, private meeting details, or project-specific facts.',
        'Active contracts inform market relevance only. They are not public evidence and must never be cited or described.',
      ],
      brandRules: [
        'Broadcast or media content unrelated to security uses personal-only or neutral branding.',
        'Broadcast or media security content may use Serket branding.',
        'Other topics may use Serket branding only when the brief includes a credible, specific how-we-help section.',
      ],
      webinarRules: [
        'Do not duplicate or preempt a planned webinar topic.',
        'A supporting angle is allowed when it does not reveal the webinar thesis or reduce launch value.',
        'When no webinar inventory is supplied, require manual webinar review before drafting.',
      ],
      currentWebinarTopics: [],
      automaticPublishingAllowed: false,
    },
  },
}];

nodes.name: Plan Dynamic Editorial Portfolio via gpt-oss

parameters.content:
## Inactive local migration
Separate copy; schedule disabled and disconnected. All model stages use LiteLLM home-chat with separate extraction, privacy, evidence-ranking and editorial calls. All file inputs/outputs use the isolated acceptance directory. Bind dedicated IAS credentials; never activate without explicit approval. No drafting, image generation, messaging or publishing.

## Natural-language editorial planner v1.6.3

Inactive evaluation copy.

The v1.6.2 sentence-case control remains active. Generic trailing title words such as guidance and principles are removed only from explanatory planning sentences. Candidate topics, validated headlines, source URLs, and evidence remain unchanged.

This prevents phrases such as operating approach to guidance and principles affects while preserving acronyms and recognized product names. The verified-candidate gate, deterministic image direction, dynamic industry preferences, broadcast branding, webinar review, and no-publication controls remain active. Content Enrichment v4.6 or later is required.
